en.summary: This commit contains real floating-point datapath fixes in Gemmini. The clearest reusable bug is the mismatch between IEEE-format float storage and the recoded-width parameters passed into HardFloat helper modules.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says the change fixes floating-point bugs.
Arithmetic.scala is central DUT arithmetic logic, and the patch changes how operands and results are encoded at the floating-point operator boundary.
Using recoded widths where IEEE widths are required directly corrupts floating-point MAC, cast, compare, and resize behavior.
disqualifiers: GemminiConfigs.scala also changes generated header/type information and is not needed for the hardware reinjection path.
The patch also rewrites some float helper bodies, but the most clearly supported bug mechanism is the IEEE-versus-recoded width fix.
evidence: The patch changes recFNFromFN, MulAddRecFN, fNFromRecFN, CompareRecFN, INToRecFN, and RecFNToRecFN calls from recExpWidth/recSigWidth-style parameters to expWidth/sigWidth.
Float.bits is reduced from expWidth + sigWidth + 1 to expWidth + sigWidth, so the bundle now matches IEEE encoding rather than a recoded width.
The affected code sits in Arithmetic.scala inside FloatArithmetic helper methods used by floating-point MAC, add, width-conversion, compare, and activation paths.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: The bug is at the boundary between architecturally stored floating-point values and an internal recoded floating-point library. If the wrapper around the floating-point unit treats an IEEE-encoded operand or result as though it already had recoded width, the helper modules interpret the bit pattern with the wrong format assumptions. That produces numerically wrong results even though the surrounding pipeline control is unchanged.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Any datapath operation that converts a stored floating-point operand into an internal recoded format, or converts a recoded result back to the architectural format.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Reintroduce a format-width mismatch so the wrapper passes recoded-width parameters where IEEE-width parameters are required, or stores the external float bundle at recoded width.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: restore wrong format parameters at a floating-point wrapper boundary
portability_notes: Look for any adapter layer between the DUT's architectural float representation and a recoded or internal FPU representation.
The portable bug is not Gemmini-specific; it applies to any DUT that uses helper modules with explicit exponent/significand parameters.
A single wrong width at the boundary is enough; you do not need to reproduce every float helper change from the original commit.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the wrapper code that packs or unpacks floating-point operands for the internal FPU library.
Change the helper instantiation or conversion calls so they use recoded/internal widths instead of the architectural IEEE exponent and significand widths.
If the design stores a float bundle or operand struct, widen it to the internal recoded width instead of the architectural width.
Run a floating-point MAC or conversion workload and check for numerically incorrect outputs without changing control flow.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: FloatArithmetic helper methods and Float bundle definition
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes HardFloat helper calls to use IEEE expWidth/sigWidth and shrinks Float.bits so stored operands/results match IEEE encoding rather than recoded encoding.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Reintroduce recExpWidth/recSigWidth-style parameters in recFNFromFN, MulAddRecFN, fNFromRecFN, CompareRecFN, and RecFNToRecFN calls, and size Float.bits as expWidth + sigWidth + 1.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Floating-point multiply-add, width conversion, or comparison results become numerically incorrect because operands or results are misencoded at the FPU wrapper boundary.
evidence_for_injection: The patch consistently replaces recoded-width parameters with IEEE-width parameters across multiple float helper calls.
The Float bundle width itself is corrected in the same commit, tying the bug to representation mismatch rather than to one isolated operator.
The changed logic is in the DUT arithmetic path, not in tests or host software.
notes: This entry intentionally grounds the injection plan on the format-width mismatch because it is the cleanest cross-DUT reinjection point.
The commit also adjusts rounding-mode choices and rewrites shift/relu6 helper bodies, but those are not required to recreate the core supported fault.

zh.summary: 该提交包含真实的 Gemmini 浮点数据通路修复。最清晰、最可复用的错误机制，是 IEEE 格式浮点存储与传给 HardFloat 辅助模块的 recoded 位宽参数之间的不匹配。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确说明这是浮点 bug 修复。
Arithmetic.scala 是核心 DUT 算术逻辑，补丁修改了浮点操作边界上操作数和结果的编码方式。
在需要 IEEE 位宽的地方误用 recoded 位宽，会直接破坏浮点 MAC、转换、比较和位宽调整行为。
disqualifiers: GemminiConfigs.scala 同时修改了生成的头文件和类型信息，但这不是硬件故障回注所必需的部分。
补丁还重写了部分浮点辅助逻辑，但最有依据、最清晰的错误机制仍然是 IEEE 与 recoded 位宽修复。
evidence: 补丁把 recFNFromFN、MulAddRecFN、fNFromRecFN、CompareRecFN、INToRecFN 和 RecFNToRecFN 等调用从 recExpWidth/recSigWidth 风格参数改成了 expWidth/sigWidth。
Float.bits 从 expWidth + sigWidth + 1 缩减为 expWidth + sigWidth，使 bundle 与 IEEE 编码匹配，而不是使用 recoded 宽度。
受影响代码位于 Arithmetic.scala 的 FloatArithmetic 辅助方法中，直接服务于浮点 MAC、加法、位宽转换、比较和激活路径。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该错误位于架构可见浮点表示与内部 recoded 浮点库之间的边界。如果 FPU 包装层把 IEEE 编码的操作数或结果当成已经是 recoded 宽度的数据处理，辅助模块就会用错误的格式假设解释位模式。即使周围流水控制不变，也会得到错误的数值结果。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: IEEE 到 recoded 浮点边界处理
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 任何把存储态浮点操作数转换为内部 recoded 格式，或把 recoded 结果转换回架构格式的数据通路操作。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 重新引入格式位宽不匹配，在需要 IEEE 位宽的地方传入 recoded 位宽参数，或者把外部浮点 bundle 按 recoded 宽度存储。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 在浮点包装层边界恢复错误的格式参数
portability_notes: 查找 DUT 中架构浮点表示与内部 FPU 表示之间的任何适配层。
这个可移植错误并不依赖 Gemmini；任何显式传递指数位宽和尾数位宽参数的设计都可能出现。
只需在边界处恢复一个错误位宽即可，不需要复现原提交中的所有浮点辅助改动。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位把浮点操作数打包到内部 FPU 库、或从其中解包的包装代码。
修改辅助模块实例化或转换调用，使其使用 recoded 或内部位宽，而不是架构层的 IEEE 指数位宽和尾数位宽。
如果设计存储了浮点 bundle 或操作数字段，把它扩成内部 recoded 宽度，而不是架构宽度。
运行浮点 MAC 或浮点转换工作负载，检查在控制流不变的情况下是否出现数值错误。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: FloatArithmetic 辅助方法与 Float bundle 定义
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复把 HardFloat 辅助调用改为使用 IEEE 的 expWidth/sigWidth，并缩小 Float.bits，使存储的操作数和结果匹配 IEEE 编码，而不是 recoded 编码。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 recFNFromFN、MulAddRecFN、fNFromRecFN、CompareRecFN 和 RecFNToRecFN 等调用恢复为 recExpWidth/recSigWidth 风格参数，并把 Float.bits 改回 expWidth + sigWidth + 1。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 由于 FPU 包装层边界上的操作数或结果被错误编码，浮点乘加、位宽转换或比较结果会出现数值错误。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁在多处浮点辅助调用中一致地把 recoded 位宽参数替换成 IEEE 位宽参数。
同一提交还修正了 Float bundle 自身的位宽，说明问题是表示不匹配，而不是单个操作器孤立错误。
变更位于 DUT 算术路径，而不是测试或主机软件。
notes: 本条目将故障注入计划锚定在格式位宽不匹配上，因为这是最清晰、最适合跨 DUT 复用的回注点。
该提交也调整了舍入模式并重写了 shift/relu6 辅助逻辑，但复现核心、可证实的故障并不需要这些改动。
